newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian OLO market closed for Christmas.
newsitem.headline: Belgian OLO market closed for Christmas.

text.p: 0800 GMT - Capital, money markets closed until Friday for Christmas when dull trade is expected as most traders have already closed their books. Benchmark 2006 OLO closed steady on Christmas eve, yielding an unchanged 5.90 pct BE283= ; yld sprd 10 bps over Bunds (10) MEUR ; OLO fut +0.03 at 121.38 BGBc1 ; Mark/Bfr 20.6000/30 (6015/30); 1-wk repo 3.05/08 (05/07).
